description: BP08 consumer-side contract for the TT05-owned fork/exec operation ledger. BP08 declares what it consumes (intended operation IDs, barriers, actual syscall success/failure, expected birth/successful-exec transitions); TT05 owns ledger execution. No expected exec generation comes from the producer identity under test. Live H01/H03/H08 cells are NOT_RUN until the TT05 live binding exists.
title: bp08-producer-ledger-record

op_notes.fork: Birth-hook identity for the non-thread child; parent and child identities recorded.
op_notes.clone_thread: Not a new process: no new task ticket is minted.
op_notes.exec_success: Successful exec advances the same task's generation; predecessor retires.
op_notes.exec_failed: Failed exec is a non-transition: the generation does not advance.
op_notes.barrier: Ordering barrier between operations; carries no identity.
